parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 500 domain names in each call.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

>  The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). If you do not set this parameter, all ISPs are queried.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the region. If you do not set this parameter, data in all regions is queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod describe-vod-domain-real-time-qps-data --domain-name example.com --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en shanghai --start-time 2019-12-02T11:25:00Z --end-time 2019-12-02T11:26:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vod DescribeVodDomainRealTimeQpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2019-12-02T11:26:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn shanghai --StartTime '2019-12-02T11:25:00Z'
